summary: Knight-Hennessy Scholars funds graduate study in any of Stanford's seven schools for up to three years, for students from anywhere in the world, with a leadership programme alongside the degree. The 2026 cohort had 87 new scholars.
covers: Tuition for up to three years of graduate study at Stanford.
A stipend for living and academic expenses.
A travel stipend for one annual trip to and from Stanford.
The King Global Leadership Program — a leadership curriculum alongside your degree.
eligibility: Applicants of any nationality applying to a full-time graduate degree at Stanford (master's, PhD, MBA, JD, MD and more).
For the 2027 cohort, a first bachelor's degree earned in 2020 or later (current students who graduate by September 2027 are eligible).
Selection looks for independence of thought, purposeful leadership and a civic mindset.
how_to_apply: Submit the Knight-Hennessy application by 6 October 2026 at 1 pm Pacific Time.
Separately apply to your Stanford graduate programme — by 1 December 2026, or the programme's own earlier deadline — to stay eligible.
Finalists attend an immersion weekend at Stanford in the new year; offers follow in the spring.
watch_out: The Knight-Hennessy deadline (early October) comes months before most Stanford programme deadlines.
You must be admitted to the Stanford programme too; the scholarship does not guarantee admission.
The bachelor's-degree year window moves forward each cycle — check it for your cohort.
